reviewers.name: specification-fidelity
reviewers.assign: Specification fidelity: group 1 of references/review-dimensions.md, every check whose Look for names an item's Interface: or Acceptance:, and temporal compatibility of the interfaces and stored formats the change alters

reviewers.name: failure-handling
reviewers.assign: Failure handling: groups 5, 6, 7 and 9 of references/review-dimensions.md (errors, concurrency and resources, the AWS runtime, logging and observability), plus PY-ARC-03, plus temporal compatibility at run time (mixed versions, migration order, replay, rollback after new writes, partial deployment)

reviewers.name: types-and-design
reviewers.assign: Types and design: groups 2, 3, 4, 10 and 12 of references/review-dimensions.md, plus the shared core/review/principles-and-architecture-smells.md

reviewers.name: security
reviewers.assign: Safety/security: every group of references/security-dimensions.md whose trigger in its Contents the change or the repository meets (a trigger you cannot rule out is met), on the Python sources, the configuration and the dependency, lock and installer files of the change; a group whose trigger is not met is unread and reported not applicable with the reason. Every group appears on the Groups line with its outcome, and one left unsure or needing runtime verification also on the Could not complete line. You own this dimension for every file of the change, the security consequence of a defect that a group of references/review-dimensions.md describes included; a defect outside security that you notice is an out-of-lens head line only, naming the lens that owns it

reviewers.name: iac-security-handoff
reviewers.assign: groups 4 (IAM) and 5 (Secrets and data exposure) of the review file of each path's stack (CloudFormation for a template, CDK for a construct), on the paths the hand-off reason names

reviewers.name: terraform-security-handoff
reviewers.assign: groups 3 (IAM) and 4 (Exposure and data protection) of the Terraform review file, on the paths the hand-off reason names
